evidence: Homepage shows 6 template cards (Professional Resume, Professional Email, Weekly Status Report, Meeting Minutes, Project Proposal, Academic Research Summary), each with author name and description.

Each card displays title (e.g. "Professional Resume"), author ("Sarah Chen"), description, category tag ("Business"), scenario tag ("Resume"), usage count ("1,250 uses"), and update date ("Updated 2024-12-01").
Clicking "Use Template" on Professional Resume opened a dialog with template details (category, scenario, author, uses) and a "Fill Template" tab showing the customizable form.

Form shows all 14 fields defined by template (Full Name, Job Title, Email, Phone, Professional Summary, Company Name, Position, Start Date, End Date, Responsibilities, Degree, School, Graduation Year, Skills), each with an editable textbox.

Before filling, dialog shows a warning: "Required fields missing - Please fill in: Full Name, Job Title, Email, Professional Summary, Company Name, Position, Start Date, Responsibilities, Degree, School, Graduation Year, Skills" and the "Preview Result" tab is disabled.

After filling all required fields, Preview Result tab became enabled and showed generated content with values substituted (e.g., "Jane Smith", "Software Engineer", "jane.smith@example.com", "Tech Corp — Senior Developer").
Preview tab was disabled before all required fields were filled, and became enabled only after every required field had a value.

Preview renders proper Markdown: H1 "Jane Smith", bold job title, separator line, H2 headings (Professional Summary, Experience, Education, Skills), H3 subheading, italic date range, all placeholders replaced with filled values.
Markdown template (Professional Resume) rendered as formatted headings, bold/italic text, and separators after field substitution, confirming Markdown rendering works correctly.
Clicking "Copy to Clipboard" showed a toast notification "Copied to clipboard! The generated content has been copied."

issue: Email format not validated before enabling preview
actual: Entering "not-an-email" (invalid email format) into the required Email field did not disable/block the Preview Result tab; the preview generated successfully and displayed "not-an-email" directly in the output text without any validation error.
evidence: Preview showed "Software Engineer | not-an-email | +1 555 123 4567" with invalid email accepted.

Entering special characters (# * [ ] ( ) |) in Full Name field triggered inline error "Special characters like < > { } [ ] \\ | ` are not allowed" and disabled the Preview Result tab, preventing generation with unsafe Markdown-breaking characters.
Clicking the heart icon on "Professional Resume" card immediately updated the Favorites button badge from no count to "1" and the heart button became active/filled state.
Favorited "Professional Resume" via heart icon; clicking "Favorites" header button opened a favorites-only view showing "Showing 1 of 6 templates" with only the favorited template listed.

Within the favorites-only view, typing "Resume" in the search box filtered to matching favorited template and displayed a suggestion dropdown "Professional Resume" while remaining in favorites-only mode (still 1 of 6 total, favorites active).

actual: Searching "Resme" and "Reusme" (small typos of "Resume") both returned "Showing 0 of 6 templates" with "No templates found" message and no suggestions, instead of matching "Professional Resume". Search appears to only support exact substring matching, not fuzzy/typo-tolerant matching.
evidence: Search box with "Reusme" shows 0 results and "No templates found".

Typing "Resu" (4 matching characters) showed a real-time suggestion dropdown "Professional Resume"; clicking it filled the search box with "Professional Resume" and narrowed results to "Showing 1 of 6 templates" matching only that template.

Category filter "Resume" narrowed to 1/6; Scenario filter "Academic" narrowed to 1/6 (Academic Research Summary); Sort "Alphabetical" reordered cards correctly to Academic Research Summary, Meeting Minutes, Professional Email, Professional Resume, Project Proposal, Weekly Status Report. Default "Most Popular" sort shows descending usage counts.

All filter/sort/search/favorites changes updated the "Showing X of 6 templates" count and card list instantly in the same page without any navigation/reload (URL remained http://localhost:6089/ throughout).
Clicking "Submit Template" with all fields blank showed toast "Missing required fields - Please fill in all required fields." and the dialog remained open without submitting.

Submitted a custom Markdown template "Simple Thank You Note" with title, description, author "QA Tester", category "Other", scenario "Business", Markdown content with placeholders, and 2 defined fields (recipientName, reason). Submission succeeded with toast "Template submitted! Your template has been added to the library."

issue: Field-to-placeholder mapping not validated on submission; unresolved placeholders appear in preview
actual: Submitted a custom template whose content contained placeholders {{recipientName}}, {{reason}}, {{senderName}} but only declared fields "recipientName" and "reason" (no field for senderName). Submission succeeded without any error. After filling recipientName="Alex" and reason="your continued support" and viewing the preview, the output showed "Dear {{recipientName}}," (unresolved, likely due to case-sensitivity: field mapped to lowercase key {{recipientname}}) and "Best, {{senderName}}" (unresolved, no matching field at all) - both left as literal unresolved placeholder text in the final preview.
evidence: Preview text: "Dear {{recipientName}}," / "Thank you for your continued support. We appreciate your business." / "Best, {{senderName}}"

After submission, "Simple Thank You Note" appeared as a new card in the library (7 of 7 templates); clicking its "Use Template" button opened the fill-form dialog with its defined fields (recipientName, reason).

Immediately after clicking Submit Template, the library count updated in-place from "Showing 6 of 6 templates" to "Showing 7 of 7 templates" and the new card appeared, without any page reload/navigation.

issue: Duplicate field labels are not rejected or disambiguated
actual: Added two fields both labeled "Name" (both mapping to the same placeholder key {{name}}) in the Submit Template form; no warning or rejection appeared, and clicking "Submit Template" succeeded, creating "Duplicate Field Test" in the library with two identically-labeled, identically-mapped fields.
evidence: Two "Name" field cards both showing "{{name}}" appeared in Define Template Fields without error; submission succeeded (toast "Template submitted!").

After navigating/reloading http://localhost:6089/, the Favorites button still shows count "1" (Professional Resume remained favorited), and both previously submitted custom templates ("Simple Thank You Note" and "Duplicate Field Test") still appear in the library, which now shows "Showing 8 of 8 templates".
